name: aipe-magnetics-database
description: Magnetic data expert: standardised material, core-geometry and measurement data (Princeton MagNet, Paderborn LEA, OpenMagnetics MAS, HEFMAG and more) with provenance, licences and duplicate tracking, served read-only by the aipe-magnetics-database Python package through its local MCP server (no LLM arithmetic, no cloud services, no API keys).
